id: title:ella-c-ph:preserve sections during free form tile drags

review.posthog_relevance: Dashboard grid layout restoration and collision handling, specifically preserving item positions when restoring a dashboard state to avoid overlapping tiles.
review.reason: The change implements a bounded, substantive capability: adding a parameter and conditional checks to preserve item positions during dashboard restoration and collision handling. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 establish the core restoration and overlap preservation logic. P1.F3.H1 demonstrates the conditional application of this behavior. observations.behavior: Adds a parameter to restoreUnmovedItemPositions and its callers, and a new conditional check.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows dashboard layout restoration to preserve positions of items that would otherwise overlap an active tile, rather than moving them away.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check using the new parameter to preserve overlapping items.
observations.posthog_connection: Preserves the position of a restored item if it overlaps the active tile, provided the caller requested this behavior.

observations.behavior: Passes a computed boolean to restoreUnmovedItemPositions and compactInteraction, and passes a boolean to compactInteraction.

P1.F5.H1 adds collision-aware placement and P1.F5.H2 wires it into the stable compaction switch.
